issue.title: Don't fire the startup event until the vert.x producer has been initialized

body:

		logger.debug("Application {} is starting ...",  SERVICE_NAME);
		...
		
	}

	void onStop(@Observes ShutdownEvent ev) {
		logger.debug("Application {} is stopping ...",  SERVICE_NAME);
	}

}

I have the feeling that there is a race condition between the registration of this bean and the https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/47e5552eb7b914bb394ee11b700bc8ee54636660/extensions/vertx-core/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/vertx/core/runtime/VertxCoreRecorder.java#L56 since both are with the same scope. 

Or am I doing something wrong?
@gastaldi , can we reopen this issue or I should create new one?
Pls create a new one. I think that the problem is that `init(@Observes Router router)` is probably called before the `VertxCoreProducer` is initialized.
